name: development/test tooling catch-up on Ruby 3.1 (rubocop 1.28 → 1.92, annotate → annotaterb, database_cleaner 2)

changes.rubocop_capybara: added 3.1.0 (rubocop-rspec 3 moved the Capybara cops here)
changes.rubocop_factory_bot: added 2.28.0 (rubocop-rspec 3 moved the FactoryBot cops here)
changes.rubocop_transitive: parser 3.3.11.1 → 3.3.13.0, unicode-display_width 2.6.0 → 3.3.0, new lint_roller 1.1.0, language_server-protocol 3.17.0.6, unicode-emoji 4.3.0; rubocop-ast 1.50.0 / regexp_parser 2.12.0 / parallel 1.28.0 / rainbow 3.1.1 unchanged
changes.rubocop_yml: `require:` → `plugins:` listing all four extensions; Metrics/BlockLength `IgnoredMethods` → `AllowedMethods` (1.9x rejects the old key as obsolete); every existing exclusion/disable kept with its comment
changes.annotaterb: added 4.25.0; `rails g annotate_rb:install` generated .annotaterb.yml and lib/tasks/annotate_rb.rake; lib/tasks/auto_annotate_models.rake deleted
changes.annotaterb_yml: carries over the old rake-task options: position after the class, show_indexes/show_foreign_keys false, hide_limit_column_types integer,boolean, tests/fixtures/serializers excluded, factories annotated; classified_sort false so columns stay in DB order. `annotaterb models` run against the test schema reports 'Model files unchanged' — existing annotations are byte-identical
changes.database_cleaner_active_record: added 2.2.2 (+ database_cleaner-core 2.1.0); spec/support/initializers/database_cleaner.rb requires 'database_cleaner/active_record'; strategy/cleaning hooks unchanged (valid single-ORM 2.x API)
changes.shoulda_matchers: 5.3.0 → 6.5.0 (no spec needed changing: only validate_presence_of is used)
changes.selenium_webdriver: 4.9.0 → 4.32.0 (newest 4.x allowing Ruby 3.1; effectively unused, no spec is js: true)
changes.faker: 3.4.2 → 3.6.1 (plan estimated 3.5.x; 3.6.1 is the newest release whose required_ruby_version admits 3.1)

rubocop.after_bump_before_fixes: 160 files inspected, 56 offenses in 14 files, 25 autocorrectable: RSpec/IndexedLet 22, Capybara/RSpec/HaveContent 13, Layout/ExtraSpacing 7, RSpec/NoExpectationExample 6, RSpec/ExpectInLet 3, Capybara/RSpec/NegationMatcher 2, Style/StringLiterals 2, Rails/FilePath 1
rubocop.autocorrect_commit: `rubocop -a` touched 12 files, 38 lines: spacing/alignment, have_content → have_text, not_to have_content → to have_no_text, single quotes in the generated rake file, Rails.root.join in spec/rails_helper.rb
rubocop.manual_commit: spec/rails_helper.rb fixture_path → Rails.root.join('spec/fixtures').to_s (clears the Style/RedundantInterpolation the autocorrect left behind, keeps a String)

cops_disabled_or_scoped.RSpec/IndexedLet: disabled — SolutionPair specs name the pair solution1/solution2 and inputs initial_cost1/iteration_cost2 (22 offences, one file); renaming is churn without behaviour benefit
cops_disabled_or_scoped.RSpec/NoExpectationExample: AllowedPatterns + ^validate_schema!$ (smoke helper raises on schema mismatch); Exclude spec/factories_lint_spec.rb (FactoryBot.lint raises; cop only pattern-matches receiver-less calls)
cops_disabled_or_scoped.RSpec/ExpectInLet: Exclude spec/smoke/**/*_spec.rb — smoke specs deliberately fail fast inside let with the HTTP response in the message

tests.rspec: 366 examples, 0 failures, 6 pending (pre-existing 'Not yet implemented' view specs); line coverage 91.98%
tests.smoke_dry_run: rspec spec/smoke --tag smoke --dry-run: 49 examples load, 0 failures

held_back.simplecov_1x: needs Ruby 3.3 — rides with the Ruby phase
held_back.rubocop_rake_rubocop_rspec_rails: suggested by rubocop, not adopted (not in the phase spec)

notes.spec_semantics: no spec expectation or app behaviour changed; all spec edits are alias/layout rewrites from rubocop -a
notes.next: Phase 11 (Rails 7.0 → 7.1) depends on this PR: annotate 3.2.0 would not load there, and rspec-rails will deprecate config.fixture_path in favour of fixture_paths
